notes:
Church Recorder 0.2.1

- Search your imported church list instantly by church name, location, or stream alias.
- Search ignores capitalization and accents, and supports multiple words.
- A pinned search field, Clear button, result count, and helpful no-match message make large lists easier to navigate.
- Existing selected/online filters and recording selections are preserved. Search text survives returning to the screen and activity recreation.
- Status refreshes update the results without replacing the search input while you type.

Install over the existing app, or use Settings → Check for updates now in version 0.2.0. Android asks before installing. This personal preview still needs a full phone check.
